raw_report:
## Executive Summary

Foldseek [1] provides fast structure search via a structural alphabet, while ESM3 [2] learns joint sequence-structure representations. An independent benchmark [3] highlights accuracy–speed trade-offs.

## Methods Compared

Foldseek [1] uses 3Di tokens; ESM3 [2] uses a generative multimodal model.

## Limitations of This Report

Source [3] was abstract-only.
